messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: ur5e-manual, p. 198

16. Commissioning 16. Commissioning Descrip The following tests must be conducted before using the robot application for the first time or after tion making any modifications. • Verify all safety inputs and outputs are correctly connected. • Test all connected safety input and output, including devices common to multiple machines or robots, are functioning as intended. • Test emergency stop buttons and inputs to verify the robot stops and the brakes engage. • Test safeguard inputs to verify the robot motion stops. If safeguard reset is configured, check that it functions as intended. • Look at the initialization screen, activate the reduced input and verify the screen changes. Copyright © 2009–2025 by Universal Robots A/S. All rights reserved. • Change the operational mode to verify the mode icon changes in top right corner of PolyScope screen. • Test the 3-position enabling device to verify that pressing to the center on position enables motion in manual mode at a reduced speed. • If the Emergency Stop outputs are used, press the Emergency Stop push-button and verify that there is a stop of the whole system. • Test the system connected to Safety I/O Signals in the Installation section to verify the output changes are detected. • Determine the commissioning requirements of your robot application. UR5e 201 User Manual
